svg.title: Local Peer-to-Peer API: one-pager
svg.desc: Your browser trusts a server across the world, but not the TV next to you. Local Peer-to-Peer: pair once, the browser keeps the trust, sites get a secure pipe to the peer the user picked. Building blocks: trust between devices, local data pipes, Local HTTPS. Security model: pages never see the network; same-origin by default; the remote origin is asserted, not proven; nothing about a site before authentication; authentication, not proximity; trust is visible and revocable.

g.font-family: 'LP2P Inter', Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.tspan: WICG
Local Peer-to-Peer API
Your browser trusts a server
across the world.
Not the TV next to you.

text.font-family: 'LP2P Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

text.tspan: The user confirms a PIN or QR code.
Devices authenticate each other,
offline, without a certificate
authority.
In a local trust store, shared
across sites but never exposed
to them.
To the peer the user picked, for
that site only: data channels or
WebTransport.
Trust ceremonies, a local trust store and
per-site grants.
RTCDataChannel-style channels, or
WebTransport streams and datagrams.

text.font-family: 'LP2P Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

text.tspan: The browser as a client of HTTPS servers on
the LAN, validated against the same trust.
Pages never see the network. No addresses,
no discovery results: the browser shows
the picker.
Same-origin by default. Other origins need
an explicit allowedOrigins opt-in, as with CORS.

tspan.tspan: The remote origin is asserted, not proven.

text.tspan: Like the Origin header, it routes and isolates
but never grants anything.

tspan.tspan: Nothing about a site before authentication.

text.tspan: The origin only reaches a verified peer.
Authentication, not proximity. Being on the
same network grants nothing; safe on café Wi-Fi.
Trust is visible and revocable. Removing a
device or grant closes its sessions.
Built for offline collaboration, file sharing, local multiplayer, smart home and device
setup, media and casting, home labs, classrooms.

g.text: Spec, explainer, threat model and questionnaire
A Web platform API proposal in the WICG.

text.font-family: 'LP2P Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
